title: Observe a manually initiated reconnect or recovery

steps.instruction: Record the live session generation and fresh status before the operator action.
The operator performs one selected route interruption, vendor-app contention, or HA reload/upgrade; the runner does not initiate it.
Observe a new connected session generation for reconnect actions, or the same verified session with fresh status for vendor-app stability.
steps.expected: verified session observation and fresh status
